channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Snell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Snell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jon Horst on Tony Snell, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Horst said of Brogdon’s departure.

“Malcolm is a great person and a great player. I wish him the best in Indiana. But I don’t feel like we were forced to do anything that we didn’t want to. We made a trade with Tony Snell that freed us up to match any offers. We have an ownership group that has allowed us to do whatever we need to do [financially]. The decision on Malcolm really came down to what we thought we could get in return. Do we want to pay for what we think his market could be or do we want to see if we could get something that helps us now and going forward?”

Jon Horst on Tony Snell, Malcolm Brogdon, Nov 7, 2019. Source: wapo.st.

item.title: John Paxson on Tony Snell
item.description:
Bulls VPJohn Paxson on @670TheScore re Snell:

“Tony has had a few moments but to be very candid,he needs to play better, w/more consistency”

John Paxson on Tony Snell, Dec 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gar Forman on Tony Snell
item.description:
KC Johnson:Gar Forman on Snell:

“What was attractive about was Tony is he can shoot. We think he has terrific tools. He has great length.”

Gar Forman on Tony Snell, Jun 28, 2013. Source: Twitter.
